title: sample_play~
description: `tof/sample_play~` plays a sample once, in a loop, or as a selected segment, producing stereo audio plus a progress signal and a bang when playback finishes. Its first inlet accepts a bang for one-shot playback, a float to stop or loop playback, a `sample` message to select the sample, or a list to play a segment; the other two inlets set playback speed and duration in milliseconds.
